notes: Capital replaced, no worlds. Florence's stored location in Europe and its stored currency, the euro, are the side facts the edit forces out in every world (gives_up): Florence is now a place in Argentina (capital_of is a subproperty of located_in), and has_currency is functional. 'Florence is in Italy' stays (related_far answers Italy). Currency uses has_currency (catalogued under finance); the peso rule is a class axiom over places in Argentina. related_far[0]: the capital of Argentina is in Italy and, by capital_of being a subproperty of located_in, in Argentina too, so located_in is not exclusive there (exclusive false).

background.peso_rule: located_in value argentina ⊑ has_currency value peso

bridge_refs.peso_rule: The currency of Argentina is the Argentine peso.
